$comment: Release flags per feature (README 'Feature flags'). The firmware flag is a SCREEN decision: a feature = pre-made screens plus the UI only they use (their *_view, f1_*, ...), or a group of unfinished parts / foundations. Components and foundations not listed belong to the library (in docs + firmware): finished parts stay in so custom specs can use them; list one under a feature only when it is that screen's own UI or unfinished. docs: shown on the docs site + workbench nav; status: the label the docs show (done | wip | preview); firmware: compiled into the panel firmware (and listed in the factory deck, Home, Settings > Screens). Build-time only: tools/features.mjs reads this; `node renderer/tools/features.mjs check` (run by build.sh) fails when a shown feature needs a hidden one or a source belongs to no feature. ids: screens = spec ids (specs/<id>.json) or registered screens; components / foundations = registered ids; core = renderer/core files only this feature uses (left out of the firmware with it); cards = Home card types that open this feature's screen; docs_pages = its detail screens (spec role detail: opened from a card or a parent screen, never a deck page) that still get their own docs page (a released screen such as Light; other detail screens open only inside their parent's demo); colour = Colour page sections (colour.json groups / contrast sections) it owns besides its ids; roadmap = roadmap rows (hidden when every feature naming them is hidden).

library.label: Component library
library.about: Every component and foundation not listed under a feature below: the parts people (and custom specs) build screens with, so a finished one ships even when no shipped screen uses it.

later.about: Features held on the wip branch until they are finished (spec of contract parts, feed on the skeleton, gate green); the docs roadmap shows their rows as in progress.
